Friendzy / Classic party games / Alphabet Association

How to play Alphabet Association

Name the topic. A to Z. No gaps. Pick a topic and name items in that category in alphabetical order. Animals, food, movies, celebrities — anything goes. Drop a letter and you're out.

2–8 players~8 minBrainy & SatisfyingMemory & chain games🚗 Works in the car

How to play

  1. Group picks a topic (e.g., foods, movie titles, animals, brand names).
  2. Going around, each player names something in that category starting with the next letter.
  3. A → B → C → D and so on. No skipping.
  4. If you can't think of one in 5 seconds, you're out.
  5. First player to get through Z wins.

Example round

  • Topic: Foods — Apple, Burrito, Crepe, Donut, Éclair, Falafel...
  • Topic: Movies — Avengers, Batman, Cars, Dune, Everything Everywhere...
  • Topic: Animals — Aardvark, Bear, Catfish, Dingo... 'X'... 'Xerus!' (it's a squirrel)

Tips

  • Harder topics: brands, songs, actors, capitals of countries.
  • Look up a few X and Z entries for your topic before starting — you'll need them.
